messages:
elena_support: customer hitting 422 on tool-invoke, says payload accepted earlier today but now failing with schema validation. repro steps and payload below — billing flow blocked, customer on Dedicated.
elena_support: payload we received: ```json
{
  \"customer_id\": 89234,
  \"action\": \"charge\",
  \"billing_profile\": {
    \"currency\": \"USD\"
  },
  \"amount\": \"1000\",
  \"debug_mode\": true
}
```
elena_support: gateway returns 422 with body: ```json
{
  \"error\": \"schema validation failed\",
  \"details\": [
    {\"path\": \"/billing_profile/id\", \"message\": \"required field missing\"},
    {\"path\": \"/amount\", \"message\": \"expected integer, got string\"},
    {\"path\": \"/\", \"message\": \"additionalProperties: \"debug_mode\" is not allowed\"}
  ]
}
```
michael_eng: thanks. couple quick Qs: was this payload sent via hosted API or Dedicated private? any recent client SDK upgrades?
elena_support: Dedicated (customer has reserved capacity). Customer says they didn't change client code; we saw a spike of retries around 09:12 UTC.
ben_sre: pinging schema-bot for the tool selector trace and schema version for billing-tool v2.
schema-bot: ran selector trace for trace_id=tr_2026_03_12_0912 -> selected tool: invoice-tool@v1 (score 0.63) fallback: billing-tool@v2 (score 0.59). Schema applied: invoice-tool schema (strict) v1.0.2.
michael_eng: aha — invoice-tool schema expects billing_profile.id required and disallows extra props. Looks like the router picked the wrong tool because the payload contains `action: \"charge\"` and `amount` as a string — that lowered billing-tool score and invoice-tool matched on other fields.
elena_support: customer insists they've always used the same endpoint and only added `debug_mode=true` in a quick test. Could that extra field flip the selector?
michael_eng: yes, additional unknown top-level props can change feature extraction. Also amount being a string may bias heuristics. Two immediate mitigations: 1) strip unknown top-level keys at gateway (quick hack) 2) coerce numeric strings to ints before scoring (longer). For immediate customer unblock: strip `debug_mode` and coerce `amount` -> int then re-invoke.
elena_support: tried removing debug_mode and sending amount as number, got 200. customer back online.
ben_sre: logging recommendation: add a selector mismatch alert when schema validation error contains additionalProperties + missing required — often indicates wrong-tool routing.
michael_eng: I'll open an internal ticket to: (A) adjust selector features to ignore debug flags by default, (B) add a pre-validation normalization step to coerce simple types and drop unknown safe flags for Dedicated routing, (C) update invoice-tool schema to allow `debug_mode` as optional boolean if semantically fine.
elena_support: ticket? pls include repro payload and gateway traces. Also customer requested a patch ETA.
michael_eng: filing RN-5128 and adding repro artifacts + selector trace id. ETA for hotfix (strip unknown flags) 48 hours; schema relax/change will be next-week.
elena_support: sending customer a workaround and ETA. thanks all :thumbsup:
